title: Invalid request
message: Invalid request: {reason}.
basic_text: This chat request is missing something or has a wrong value.
fix_text: Fix the request and try again.

title: Unknown model name
message: Unknown model name {model_name}.
basic_text: There is no model with that name.
fix_text: Pick a model from the list.

title: Steering preset needs its model on the Inspectable runtime
message: The steering preset {preset_name} needs {model_name} on the Inspectable runtime.
basic_text: This steering preset only works with Rastai's own runtime.
fix_text: Switch the model to the Inspectable runtime.

title: Model not ready
message: {model_name} is not loaded.
basic_text: This model isn't loaded yet.
fix_text: Load the model.

title: The model's node is unreachable
message: The node {node_id} that serves {model_name} is unreachable.
basic_text: Rastai lost contact with the computer running this model.
fix_text: Check that the computer is on and connected.

title: Tool calls not supported for this model family
message: Tool calls are not supported for the {family} family.
basic_text: This model can't use tools.
fix_text: Pick a model that supports tool calls.

title: Generation timed out or stalled
message: Generation timed out or stalled after {timeout_seconds} seconds.
basic_text: The model stopped answering.
fix_text: Try again; if it keeps happening, reload the model.

title: Steering preset was made for different weights
message: The steering preset {preset_name} was made for different weights than {model_name}.
basic_text: This steering preset was made for another model.
fix_text: Pick a preset made for this model.

title: Inference command not available yet
message: {command_id} isn't available in this version of Rastai yet.
basic_text: This feature is planned but not built yet in this version of Rastai.
fix_text: Nothing to fix on your side: the feature arrives in a later version.

title: Tokenizer couldn't be loaded
message: The tokenizer of {model_name} couldn't be loaded: {reason}.
basic_text: Rastai couldn't load the part of the model that reads text.
fix_text: Download the model again.

title: Chat template error
message: The chat template of {model_name} failed: {reason}.
basic_text: Rastai couldn't format this conversation for the model.
fix_text: Check the model's chat template, or pick another model.

title: No tokenizer files for this model
message: {model_name} has no tokenizer files.
basic_text: This model is missing the files that read text.
fix_text: Download the model again with its tokenizer.

title: Tokenizer mismatch between the gateway and llama-server
message: The tokenizer of {model_name} differs between the gateway and llama-server.
basic_text: Two parts of Rastai read this model's text differently, so it won't use the fast engine.
fix_text: Use the Inspectable runtime, or pick a GGUF made from the same model.

title: Prompt longer than the model's context
message: The prompt is {prompt_tokens} tokens; {model_name}'s context holds {context_tokens}.
basic_text: This conversation is too long for the model. Rastai never cuts it short on its own.
fix_text: Start a new conversation, or shorten this one.

title: Template can't produce a training mask for this conversation
message: The chat template of {model_name} can't produce a training mask for this conversation.
basic_text: Rastai can't tell which parts of this conversation to train on.
fix_text: Use another chat template, or another conversation.

title: Two plugins contribute a chat template or tokenizer for this model; neither is used
message: {plugin_id} and {other_plugin_id} both contribute a chat template or tokenizer for {model_name}; neither is used.
basic_text: Two plugins both try to handle this model's text, so Rastai uses neither.
fix_text: Turn off one of the two plugins.

title: API key missing
message: The API key for {adapter_name} is missing.
basic_text: Rastai needs an API key for this service.
fix_text: Add the API key for this service.

title: API provider returned an error
message: {adapter_name} returned an error: {reason}.
basic_text: The online model service returned an error.
fix_text: Check the service's status and your API key.

title: API provider rate limit
message: {adapter_name} is rate limiting requests; wait {wait_seconds} seconds.
basic_text: The online model service asked Rastai to slow down.
fix_text: Wait a moment, then try again.

title: API connection failed or dropped
message: The connection to {adapter_name} failed or dropped: {reason}.
basic_text: Rastai lost its connection to the online model service.
fix_text: Check your connection and try again.

title: llama-server didn't become healthy
message: llama-server didn't become healthy for {model_name}: {reason}.
basic_text: The fast chat engine had a problem. It didn't start.
fix_text: Unload other models, or use a smaller GGUF.

title: llama-server stopped unexpectedly
message: llama-server stopped unexpectedly while serving {model_name}.
basic_text: The fast chat engine had a problem. It stopped.
fix_text: Load the model again.

title: Needs the Inspectable runtime
message: This needs {model_name} on the Inspectable runtime.
basic_text: This feature only works with Rastai's own runtime.
fix_text: Switch the chat to the Inspectable runtime.

title: llama-server build hash mismatch
message: The llama-server build at {path} doesn't match its pinned hash.
basic_text: The fast chat engine had a problem. Its program file didn't pass the security check.
fix_text: Reinstall Rastai.

title: Fast runtime busy
message: The Fast runtime is busy with another request.
basic_text: The fast chat engine is busy.
fix_text: Wait for the current answer to finish.

title: Malformed event from llama-server
message: llama-server sent a malformed event: {reason}.
basic_text: The fast chat engine had a problem. It sent something Rastai couldn't read.
fix_text: Load the model again.

title: No GGUF for the Fast runtime
message: {model_name} has no GGUF file for the Fast runtime.
basic_text: The fast chat engine needs a GGUF version of this model.
fix_text: Download a GGUF of this model, or export one from a checkpoint.

title: No full-precision twin for this GGUF
message: {model_name} has no full-precision twin for inspection.
basic_text: To look inside this compressed model, Rastai needs its full-size version.
fix_text: Set the full-precision twin of this model.

title: Twin doesn't match the GGUF
message: The twin {twin_model_name} doesn't match {model_name}: {reason}.
basic_text: The full-size model you picked isn't the same model as this compressed one.
fix_text: Pick the full-precision model this GGUF was made from.

title: Gateway log write failed
message: Writing the gateway log failed: {reason}.
basic_text: Rastai couldn't save this chat to its log.
fix_text: Check free disk space.
